title: rudbeckia laciniata var. heterophylla
intro: Rudbeckia laciniata var. heterophylla, commonly known as Green-Headed Coneflower, is a perennial flowering plant native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and supporting digestive function. The therapeutic actions of Rudbeckia laciniata var. heterophylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
